descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S11 「任务界面上的保留边界：医院完成任务 16 h、没完成任务在最后一次处理后 36 h，±1 h；养老院完成任务只记录」 Retention edges on the task view: Hospital completed 16 h and open 36 h after last processing, ±1 h; Nursing Home completed recorded

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • G1 UAT 3.6 on the task view, Hospital: completed tasks leave 16 h after they were done; open tasks leave 36 h after the chart was last processed (Nursing Home open tasks persist: U6)（UAT 3.6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U6 Nursing Home open tasks persist across visits (UAT 3.6: open tasks persist until changed)（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.6；TFA-92585 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Seeded Hospital patients and a Nursing Home resident whose tasks and processing stamps are back-dated from time:now at seed time

When Open the Hospital list (the context lifecycle runs on entry) → Task Export, expand the completed section; switch to Nursing Home → Task Export, expand the completed section

Then Hospital: the task completed 15 h ago is at the bottom, the one completed 17 h ago is gone; the open task on the chart processed 35 h ago is shown, the open task on the chart processed 37 h ago is gone. Nursing Home: the open task is shown; the two completed cells are recorded for Q4

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 Hospital windows (G1). s11-h-view: mustContain 'QA Hosp Ivy Chen', 'Repeat lactate', 'Arrange cardiology follow-up'; mustNotContain 'Recheck magnesium', 'Order outpatient sleep study'. Expected on main: the 37 h open-task cell fails because hospitalLifecyclePatch has no open-task clear — report it as a new Fail and raise it with Daniela, not as a known gap. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）（TIME (back-dated doneAt/notesProcessedAt from time:now; lifecycle on entry or rounding:applyLifecycle)）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
